verdict.rationale: Pylon documents an issue log for inspecting the AI agent's outcomes and steps, plus a simulation tool for testing questions. Neither describes the platform itself detecting knowledge gaps or conflicting content. Manually reviewing logs or simulations is a user-side workaround, so it earns no credit and the verdict stays at none.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, the platform surfaces knowledge gaps and conflicting content that cause the agent to miss or fumble questions
